scripts.test: pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run test:core-client && pnpm run test:main && pnpm run test:renderer && pnpm run test:integration
scripts.test:core-client: cargo build -p nodex-core-server && vp test run --config vitest.core-client.config.ts
scripts.test:core-client:related: cargo build -p nodex-core-server && vp test related --run --passWithNoTests --config vitest.core-client.config.ts
scripts.test:main: pnpm --silent run core:test-support:build:dev && node scripts/run-vitest-in-electron.mjs --config vitest.main.config.ts
scripts.test:main:related: pnpm --silent run core:test-support:build:dev && node scripts/run-vitest-in-electron.mjs --command related --run --passWithNoTests --config vitest.main.config.ts
scripts.test:integration:ci: pnpm --silent run core:test-support:build:dev && pnpm run test:integration
scripts.test:integration:ci:related: pnpm --silent run core:test-support:build:dev && node scripts/run-vitest-in-electron.mjs --command related --run --passWithNoTests --config vitest.integration.config.ts
scripts.test:main:stress: pnpm --silent run core:test-support:build:dev && NODEX_TEST_TIER=stress node scripts/run-vitest-in-electron.mjs --config vitest.main.config.ts
scripts.test:stress: pnpm run build-resources:prepare && pnpm run test:unit:stress && pnpm run test:main:stress && pnpm run test:renderer:stress && pnpm run test:browser:stress && pnpm run test:integration:stress
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm run core:binaries:build:dev && pnpm run build && playwright test --config playwright.e2e.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e:subscription: pnpm run core:binaries:build:dev && pnpm run build && playwright test --config playwright.subscription.e2e.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e:performance: pnpm run core:binaries:build:dev && pnpm run build && NODEX_E2E_INCLUDE_PERFORMANCE=1 playwright test --config playwright.e2e.config.ts --grep 'keeps representative large-content surfaces bounded|keeps Page ready and idle CPU bounded with 14k LocalCommit history|measures high-pressure nested Block transfer into a populated Board|keeps production-scale Database context menus inside the interaction budget'
scripts.test:performance: pnpm run core:benchmark:rust && pnpm run core:test:scale
scripts.codex:schemas:generate: pnpm --silent run stage:codex-runtime:mac && tsx scripts/codex-schemas.ts generate
scripts.codex:schemas:verify: pnpm --silent run stage:codex-runtime:mac && tsx scripts/codex-schemas.ts verify
scripts.test:agent-runtime-conformance: pnpm --silent run stage:codex-runtime:mac && pnpm --silent run agent-runtime:probe && pnpm --silent run agent-runtime:probe:wire && pnpm --silent run agent-runtime:probe:handoff
scripts.test:browser-runtime-conformance: pnpm --silent run stage:codex-runtime:mac && pnpm --silent run browser-runtime:probe
scripts.core:test: pnpm run core:test:full && pnpm run core:test:nightly
scripts.core:test:pr: pnpm run core:test:nextest && pnpm run core:test:docs
scripts.core:test:full: pnpm run core:test:workspace && pnpm run core:test:migration
scripts.core:test:nightly: pnpm run core:test:canvas-performance && pnpm run core:test:read-budget && pnpm run core:test:relation-scale
scripts.core:build:dev: pnpm --silent run appshot-helper:build:dev && pnpm --silent run core:binaries:build:dev
scripts.core:build:mac:arm64: MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET=12.0 cargo build --release --target aarch64-apple-darwin -p nodex-core-server -p nodex-cli -p nodex-browser-profile-helper && tsx scripts/stage-rust-core.ts --target-arch arm64 --out .generated/rust-core-runtime/arm64
scripts.core:build:mac:x64: MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET=12.0 cargo build --release --target x86_64-apple-darwin -p nodex-core-server -p nodex-cli -p nodex-browser-profile-helper && tsx scripts/stage-rust-core.ts --target-arch x64 --out .generated/rust-core-runtime/x64
scripts.core:benchmark:rust: cargo build --release -p nodex-core-server && NODEX_MEASURE_RUST_CORE_RUNTIME=1 vp test run --config vitest.core-client.config.ts src/main/core-client/rust-core-runtime-benchmark.node.test.ts
scripts.core:test:electron-authority: cargo build -p nodex-core-server --all-targets && node scripts/run-vitest-in-electron.mjs --config vitest.integration.config.ts src/main/rust-data-authority.integration.ts
scripts.core:test:packaged-cli-electron: node -e "if (!process.env.NODEX_PACKAGED_CLI) throw new Error('NODEX_PACKAGED_CLI is required')" && node scripts/run-vitest-in-electron.mjs --config vitest.integration.config.ts src/main/native-cli-electron.integration.ts
scripts.stage:sparkle-runtime:mac:arm64: pnpm --silent run materialize:sparkle:mac && tsx scripts/build-sparkle-bridge.ts --arch arm64 --channel ${NODEX_SPARKLE_CHANNEL:-disabled} --out .generated/sparkle-runtime/arm64
scripts.stage:sparkle-runtime:mac:x64: pnpm --silent run materialize:sparkle:mac && tsx scripts/build-sparkle-bridge.ts --arch x64 --channel ${NODEX_SPARKLE_CHANNEL:-disabled} --out .generated/sparkle-runtime/x64
scripts.stage:codex-runtime:mac:cached: pnpm --silent run materialize:browser-runtime:mac && tsx scripts/stage-codex-runtime.ts --target-platform darwin --target-arch $(node -p "process.arch") --out .generated/codex-runtime --browser-runtime-source .generated/browser-runtime-source/$(node -p "process.arch") --reuse-existing
scripts.stage:codex-runtime:mac:arm64: pnpm --silent run materialize:browser-runtime:mac:arm64 && tsx scripts/stage-codex-runtime.ts --target-platform darwin --target-arch arm64 --out .generated/codex-runtime --browser-runtime-source .generated/browser-runtime-source/arm64
scripts.stage:codex-runtime:mac:x64: pnpm --silent run materialize:browser-runtime:mac:x64 && tsx scripts/stage-codex-runtime.ts --target-platform darwin --target-arch x64 --out .generated/codex-runtime --browser-runtime-source .generated/browser-runtime-source/x64
scripts.stage:native-runtime:mac:arm64: pnpm --silent run stage:codex-runtime:mac:arm64 && MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET=12.0 cargo build --release --target aarch64-apple-darwin -p nodex-core-server -p nodex-cli -p nodex-browser-profile-helper && tsx scripts/stage-rust-core.ts --target-arch arm64 --out .generated/codex-runtime && pnpm --silent run stage:sparkle-runtime:mac:arm64
scripts.stage:native-runtime:mac:x64: pnpm --silent run stage:codex-runtime:mac:x64 && MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET=12.0 cargo build --release --target x86_64-apple-darwin -p nodex-core-server -p nodex-cli -p nodex-browser-profile-helper && tsx scripts/stage-rust-core.ts --target-arch x64 --out .generated/codex-runtime && pnpm --silent run stage:sparkle-runtime:mac:x64
scripts.build: pnpm --silent run appshot-helper:build:dev && tsx scripts/prepared-electron-build.ts build
scripts.package:mac: pnpm run build && pnpm run stage:native-runtime:mac && tsx scripts/prepared-electron-build.ts verify && electron-builder --mac --publish never
scripts.package:mac:arm64: pnpm run build && pnpm run stage:native-runtime:mac:arm64 && tsx scripts/prepared-electron-build.ts verify && electron-builder --mac dmg --arm64 --publish never
scripts.package:mac:x64: pnpm run build && pnpm run stage:native-runtime:mac:x64 && tsx scripts/prepared-electron-build.ts verify && electron-builder --mac dmg --x64 --publish never
scripts.package:all: pnpm run build && pnpm run stage:codex-runtime:mac && electron-builder -mwl
scripts.verify:source: pnpm run verify:static && pnpm run core:fmt && pnpm run core:clippy && pnpm run core:test && pnpm run test && pnpm run test:stress && pnpm run test:browser
scripts.verify:runtime:mac: pnpm run codex:schemas:verify && pnpm run test:agent-runtime-conformance && pnpm run test:browser-runtime-conformance
